key.name: enable-pacman
key.description: Use checkupdates (pacman-contrib) to check official Arch Linux repositories.

key.name: aur-helper
key.description: Which AUR helper to use: auto, yay, paru, or disabled.

key.name: enable-flatpak
key.description: Check and apply updates for installed Flatpak applications and runtimes.

key.name: enable-gearlever
key.description: Check and apply updates for AppImages managed by Gearlever.

key.name: check-interval
key.description: Interval in minutes between automatic update checks.

key.name: boot-delay
key.description: Seconds to wait after enabling before running the first check.

key.name: notify-updates
key.description: Show a desktop notification when new updates are found or an update completes.

key.name: compact-mode
key.description: Use compact spacing and sizing in the top bar.

key.name: show-count
key.description: Display the number of pending updates next to the top bar icon.

key.name: hide-when-uptodate
key.description: Hide the top bar icon when there are no pending updates.

key.name: use-arch-icons
key.description: Use bundled Arch Linux symbolic icons instead of generic system icons.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Top bar box where the indicator is placed: left, center, or right.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Position index inside the chosen panel box.

key.name: debug-mode
key.description: Log detailed backend timings, subprocess diagnostics, and show a perf bar in the popup menu.
